title: Lingering healing mead
content:
# Lingering healing mead

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadHealthLingering | Source: Fermenter | Usage: Drinking | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Mead base: Lingering health x1 | Max Health: +25% health regen | Duration: 5m

# Introduction

Lingering healing mead is an Ashlands-tier consumable item fermented from Mead base: Lingering health.

## Recipe

Mead base: Lingering health is produced in a Mead ketill with:
• 10 Sap
• 10 Vineberry cluster
• 10 Smoke puff
Six Lingering healing meads are produced by fermenting the mead base for two in-game days.

## Effect

Upon consumption, it provides +25% health regeneration for 5 minutes. While active, it prevents the consumption of all types of healing meads.

Categorias: Mead, Fermenter recipes, Items
